scope.selection: Stratified purposeful sample, not a random sample. One source per session ID. Large streams capped at 60 MB in selection.
scope.raw: Raw Local inventories count mutation payload occurrences, including repeated snapshots and updates. Never treat them as unique conversation parts.
scope.final: Local final inventories replay all mutation kinds 0/1/2/3 first, including truncate-then-push. Final response positions are not deduplicated by tool lifecycle ID.
scope.sdk: SDK inventories count every event record and all recorded agent scopes. Unique lifecycle IDs are separate metrics.
scope.normalization: Array indices and numeric keys become []. UUID/hash/call-ID map keys become {id}; absolute path/URI map keys become {path}. No primitive text values are stored except short discriminator, tool-name, state and version labels.
scope.provenance: Each inventory count includes per-source counts and up to three concrete source/line or final-state examples.
scope.privacy: Private original sources are copied solely below this ignored corpus folder. No source body or instruction text is printed.
scope.textMetrics: Lengths include every string field, including metadata/encoded data, not just reader-visible prose. They are labelled to avoid claiming a prose token total.
